message_3_subject: Re: MSA redline and insurance exhibits attached — legal review
message_3_body:
Team — thanks for the ping. Legal summary and proposed path: 

1) Additional Insured: acceptable to request wording that covers "HeliosCloud, its affiliates and customers" but we prefer the endorsement name to be a specific legal entity list when feasible. If the insurer can issue CG 2011 (additional insured — ongoing operations) naming "HeliosCloud, Inc." we'll accept. If they propose a carrier-specific endorsement, ask for the carrier to provide the exact endorsement text for review.

2) Waiver of Subrogation: we can accept Waiver of Subrogation where allowed by law; request broker confirm state law implications (CA sometimes restricts). If carrier cannot issue blanket waiver, we can accept a carrier letter acknowledging they will waive subrogation for this MSA only.

3) Primary & Non-Contributory: require CGL to be primary and non-contributory; carrier confirmation in writing is necessary.

4) Cyber: require Retroactive Date = MSA effective date OR evidence from carrier showing prior-acts coverage. If carrier uses claim-made policy and retroactive date is later than our effective date, we need a carrier attestation that prior acts are covered or an extended reporting period.

5) Evidence delivery: prefer COI + endorsement PDF from broker including the exact endorsement wording. COIs should be emailed to contracts@redwood.com and uploaded to our HubSpot deal record. DocuSign envelope for the order form is acceptable for signature, but COI/endorsement must arrive prior to countersignature.

Action items:
- Maria: send sample COI + endorsement (PDF) and carrier contact info by EOD 2027-04-08.
- David/Aditya: confirm whether we can accept carrier-letter alternatives if the exact CG form is unavailable.
- Lauren: hold signature until evidence is uploaded; we can provisionally reserve execution for 4/20 if documents arrive on time.

I'm attaching a short endorsement example (CG-2011 style) — request broker to provide comparable text.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
message_4_subject: Re: sample endorsement and carrier confirmation (HeliosCloud)
message_4_body:
David / Kimberly / Michael — thanks for the clarification. Quick update from the broker / carrier side: 

- Carrier: Liberty Shield Insurance Co. (A.M. Best A-) can issue Additional Insured endorsements. They typically issue their ISO variant (carrier-amended CG 2011) with the insured name(s) specified. Per your ask, we can list "HeliosCloud, Inc." and its affiliated entities — carriers prefer specific legal names; generic "customers" is tricky.

- Waiver of Subrogation: carrier can agree to Waiver of Subrogation for General Liability and Workers' Comp where allowed by state law. For California, we will need the waiver to be specifically endorsed — we can provide the endorsement text or a letter from the carrier stating waiver will be honored for this contract.

- Primary & Non-Contributory: carrier will provide written confirmation on the COI/endorsement that the policy is primary and non-contributory for the operations covered by the MSA.

- Cyber: the carrier can provide evidence of prior-acts coverage. If the retroactive date on the carrier's policy predates the MSA effective date, we will include carrier attestation. If not, we can add Extended Reporting Period (ERP) for the policy term where feasible.

Attached: CG-2011_AddlIns_Endorsement_Sample.pdf (carrier-form), carrier_response_0427.txt (text from underwriter confirming acceptance).

Requested next steps: please confirm whether Redwood will accept the carrier-form endorsement naming HeliosCloud, Inc. (we have limitations on an open "customers" phrase). If acceptable, I'll instruct carrier to issue COI + endorsement and send a signed waiver letter where applicable. Target delivery: 2027-04-12.

Regards,
Maria Santos
Senior Broker, ACME Risk Partners
maria@acmebroker.com
